query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_obs, COUNT(DISTINCT p.empresa) as distinct_empresas 
FROM cobranca_etapa_obs o 
JOIN cobranca_planilha p ON o.planilha_id = p.id 
WHERE p.ativo = 1;
